problem: prepare_revision_qualification listed the qualification collection (project_knowledge) by (run_id, revision_id) and required EXACTLY the 27 qualification records (1 revision + 10 phase + 16 required-artifact). Governance/audit records that legitimately share that keyspace (the deletion-free Memory daemon cannot relocate them) were reported as unexpected_keys, blocking requalification with BLOCKED_MEMORY_RECORD_KEYS_MISMATCH. This was gate over-matching (selecting by raw keyspace), not record pollution.
fix: scope_qualification_documents() selects qualification records by record identity: a record is a qualification record only when its schema (persona_dream.pipeline_revision/phase/artifact_ref.v1), its record_type (revision/phase/required_artifact), AND its stable-key prefix (pd_rev_/pd_phase_/pd_artifact_) all agree. Governance records (matching none of the three axes) are readable but never counted. A record that claims a qualification schema/type/key but is inconsistent is malformed -> fail closed (BLOCKED_MEMORY_QUALIFICATION_RECORD_MALFORMED). Duplicate qualification keys fail closed (BLOCKED_MEMORY_QUALIFICATION_RECORD_DUPLICATE). validate_exact_records and validate_semantic_pointers both operate on the scoped qualification subset only.
